title: RL-PaO: Prediction as Action in Decision Making under Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2609.37065v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Decision-making under uncertainty often relies on predicted parameters, yet accurate prediction does not necessarily lead to good operational decisions. Aligning prediction with downstream optimization requires learning from the consequences of the decisions those predictions induce. We introduce RL-PaO, a reinforcement learning framework that integrates system formulation, optimization, and decision execution into a single environment. This yields a Markov decision process in which prediction is regarded as action: it shifts the environment to produce subsequent context and reward that explicitly aligns prediction error with realized cost, and learning the optimal policy does not require differentiating through the black-box solver. We evaluate RL-PaO on day-ahead energy scheduling using real historical data. translated_title: RL-PaO：不确定性决策中将预测作为动作的方法
translated_abstract: 不确定性下的决策通常依赖于预测得到的参数，然而预测的准确性并不必然带来良好的运营决策。要使预测与下游优化对齐，需要从这些预测所引发的决策后果中学习。我们提出了RL-PaO，这是一个将系统建模、优化与决策执行整合到单一环境中的强化学习框架。由此构建出一个马尔可夫决策过程，其中预测被视为动作：预测改变环境，产生后续的上下文与奖励，从而显式地将预测误差与实际成本对齐，并且学习最优策略无需对黑箱求解器进行求导。我们使用真实历史数据在日前能源调度任务上评估了RL-PaO。在测试年度，RL-PaO在非神谕基线方法中取得了最低的年度总成本，平均实现了约10%的成本降低。
tldr: RL-PaO将预测视为强化学习中的动作，通过把预测误差与实际决策成本显式对齐，在无需对黑箱优化求解器求导的情况下，在日前能源调度中实现了约10%的成本降低。
en_tdlr: RL-PaO treats prediction as an action in reinforcement learning, explicitly aligning prediction error with realized cost, enabling about 10% cost reduction in day-ahead energy scheduling without differentiating through the black-box solver.
